title: Volume 1 Chapter 4: Dungeon Practice 3
content: "Heh, isn't swimming and magic two different things?"
The pool class is like a large-scale event, conducted all at once, similar to Dungeon Practice.
It's a perfect opportunity for the protagonists from different classrooms to interact with the target characters, and the best stage to see handsome guys in swimsuits.
Since it's right after a battle in the dungeon, it feels like a reward event.
For that reason, the large pool within the academy was bustling with the reverse harem group.
"Why is a commoner here... so envious...!"
"If you have time to be jealous, then burn this scene into your mind with your inner eye!"
"Hey, hey, why don't you all come have some tea? I have some nice black tea and snacks!"
"Hey, boys, get out of my sight! Don't block my view!"

There were envious glares, as well as girls simply sending hot looks to the handsome guys in swimsuits, while behind them, mob male students shed tears of frustration, creating a ridiculous and amusing ecosystem.
"Why are we not even allowed to be in sight?!"
"We worked hard to get our bodies in shape! Is there even a chance for us?!"
Max and the other idiots lamented.
They should realize that inviting someone for tea during a pool class is wrong; even I wouldn't do something like that.
Huh? Why is there a pool class, you ask?
I have no idea...

It's said that the Ancient Sage trained water attribute magic through water exercises, and that tradition has been preserved as pool classes, but it feels like they just wanted to break the world-building to showcase handsome illustrations by the poolside.
For me, it's a blessing to behold Alicia in her swimsuit.
I don't know why it's a competitive swimsuit, but perhaps the snug fit is more appealing to girls.
"Wow, I thought I’d practice water attribute magic, but it seems impossible in this situation..."
"Isn't it dangerous to practice in a pool in the first place?"

"We're not practicing dangerous magic. We're just soaking in the pool to use water magic and grasp the imagery. Someone of Lagna's skill level should have done this kind of practice before, right...?"
"Our situation is a bit special."
While I never skip training to survive, magic practice is generally focused on practical application.
Since it's always a matter of life or death, there's no time to rely on imagery; it's all about instinctively finding the optimal solution.
It's a level of savagery that could be described as barbaric, and no matter how much practice you do, you can't display even half your skills in actual combat.
It's just a difference between dying first or dying later.
"I'm curious about what kind of practice Lagna does!"
As I was enjoying the mob experience by the poolside with Mariana, a soccer ball-sized water sphere suddenly flew towards us.
"Oh no, I slipped! Can you dodge it?!"
"Yikes!"
I heard Ekaterina's voice.
Seeing her do something silly again, I deployed a barrier in front of Mariana, but before it could activate, a fireball of the same size collided with the water sphere and evaporated it.
"Using aggressive magic incantations is not permitted in this class."
When I turned to see who it was, I found Jelasis Gran Ignite, one of the target characters, standing there.
The red-haired beauty in a black rash guard with red lines, wearing the academy's designated competitive swimsuit, was directing his inscrutable gaze at Ekaterina.
"Oh, I'm sorry! My hand slipped!"
"If it wasn't intentional, then it's fine."
What does it mean to say your hand slipped when you're told not to chant?
It must have been intentional; they should be reprimanded properly.
Ekaterina, accompanied by her entourage, approached while glancing at the reverse harem pool.
"Your Highness, you should just ignore a commoner who can't even swim. It's because of these inconsiderate commoners that practice is impossible, you know?"
That's true, but it's not just the commoners; it's Patricia's fault specifically.
When Patricia enters the pool, the princes follow suit, creating a sort of sacred space, and the boys who enter the pool are mocked and driven out by the other girls, shedding tears.
It's genuinely pitiful.
The princes only see Patricia and hear her voice, so it's hard to say they're not crazy.
As I pondered this, Jelasis replied without changing his expression.
"If you can't swim, you won't be able to practice."
"Oh, is it true that commoners can't swim?"
"You shouldn't call us commoners so casually."
"It's a fact."
While it's certainly not good to call someone a commoner, monopolizing the pool isn't good either, so I silently supported Ekaterina in my heart.
The enemy of my enemy is my friend, so go ahead and argue with her, Ekaterina.
"Edward is following the academy's rules. It's you who are disrupting them."

"Hmph, that's just pretty talk. Outside the academy, there's a distinction between commoners and nobles. What I'm doing isn't discrimination; it's differentiation. If commoners don't know their place, they'll suffer later."
"Even so, this is still the academy."
"Tch, you're just a bastard child who can't even inherit the family name."
The power word "this is the academy" caused Ekaterina to throw out a mere insult, determining the outcome of the verbal battle.
"While you say pretty things, what the princes are doing is excessive favoritism. If that's not discrimination, then I'd like you to explain the meaning of the word. Hmph, I'm leaving!"
Even after being hit with harsh words, Jelasis showed no change in his expression as Ekaterina left with her entourage, throwing a parting shot.
Jelasis's poker face was too strong.
Still, the difference between discrimination and excessive favoritism, huh?
I can understand what she's trying to say.
From the perspective of a mob, that reverse harem space really does seem like an unusual sight.
However, that doesn't justify bullying.
By the way, how is Mariana, who is not good with nobles, handling the situation with two relatively higher-ranking nobles in front of her?
"Ah, my glasses, my glasses..."
When she fell back in surprise, the impact caused her glasses to slip and become like a headband, and she was frantically searching for them.
"Wh-where did my glasses go?!"
So absorbed in her search, she didn't even hear the conversation between Ekaterina and Jelasis, and honestly, it felt miraculous to watch.
"You're having a tough time, huh?"
Finding it amusing, I decided not to tell her and left her to it, but for some reason, Jelasis started talking to me.
"...Aren't you going to join them over there?"
"I'm not good with water."
Even though I hadn't interacted with them at all since coming to the academy, why was he talking to me now?
This was the first time I had a conversation with one of the target characters.
Thinking I should use polite language since he's from a duke's family, I stayed silent, and Jelasis silently sat next to me.
...Huh? Why is he sitting next to me?
Mariana had gone off somewhere to look for her glasses, and I regretted leaving her behind.
An incredibly awkward atmosphere settled in, and I glanced sideways at Jelasis.
His expressionless gaze, staring off into the distance, gave off a dangerous aura as if he was harboring something deep within.
However, his handsome features seemed to stir a maternal instinct within me, making it hard to ignore that dangerous vibe.
In his route, there are lines and scenes where he feels like the protagonist is a mother figure, so it's clear that this character was designed with that in mind.
"You have an amazing body," he suddenly said.
I was taken aback by the sudden conversation.
"Huh? Oh, thanks, haha."
I had decided not to get involved with these guys, so I was at a loss for how to respond.
I don't talk to the boys at the academy at all, so being suddenly addressed left me flustered, unsure of how to reply.
If this were a battlefield, I could communicate through strength.
If it were enemy soldiers, I could interrogate them.
But how to talk to students wasn't something taught in the Brave Family, and I didn't have many memories of conversations from my previous life, so I panicked.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XtFOsAW.jpeg
This is the essence of being a mob.
"Where did you get those scars?"
"In Brave Territory."
It's standard for a seasoned soldier's body to be covered in scars from battles with enemies, so I gave a nonchalant answer.
I did think about putting on my rash guard to avoid scaring him, but since Alicia wasn't hiding her scars, I couldn't just act timidly as her fiancé and decided to be bold.
Scars are a point of pride; they're proof of my life.
"Is your territory always at war with a neighboring country? Your muscles look impressive, you seem strong."
"No, no, you have impressive muscles too."
Jelasis's physique, seen up close in his swimsuit, was much more toned compared to the immature academy students.
All the target characters had been practicing swordsmanship and magic since childhood, and they all had athletic builds, but Jelasis stood out with particularly high quality.
You wouldn't notice it with clothes on, but he seemed more solid than the target characters known for their martial skills.
"I guess it's the result of my family's upbringing."
"We both have our struggles, haha."
Another silence fell between us.
This is awkward! What do I do, Sebas?!
What should I do in a situation like this!?
Mariana, Alicia, come back quickly.
But even if they returned, Mariana wouldn't be able to approach, and Alicia probably wouldn't want to talk much either.
Is there any way to wrap up this conversation?
Should I go somewhere else?
But since I was the one who sat down first, it would be annoying to give up my seat.
As I was thinking this, Jelasis opened his mouth again.
"Have you ever held hands?"
"Huh?"
What’s with the sudden question?
"Have you ever been hugged?"
"No."
"Have you ever been loved by someone?"
The question assault began.
Facing Jelasis, who turned to look at me, I recalled, "Oh right, this is how he is," remembering the game version of Jelasis.
When the protagonist progresses Jelasis's flag, he begins to show interest and bombards the protagonist with questions, having previously kept a certain distance from others.
This is what I call the "Jelasis's What-What Phase."
It's a terrible naming sense, but this abrupt shift in conversation flow certainly qualifies as a "What-What Phase."
It's so disconnected that it borders on terrifying.
And he always says this—"You, interesting."
Hearing those words, I felt despair.
The fact that Jelasis was in this situation meant that the "What-What Phase" event was progressing with me.
W-Why?
We hadn't interacted at all since enrollment, so why is this happening? It feels like a bug.
"Hey, is questioning people your hobby?"
"Sorry."
Ugh, the conversation isn't progressing at all.
It seems I messed up how to respond to his questions.
Given his mysterious and dark character design, I guess it's understandable, but facing him like this was exhausting.
"Why don't you just go back? Your friends are waiting for you at the pool..."
Go back, Jelasis; this isn't your place.
The reverse harem is your place.
"I just felt curious about you."
As I told him to leave, he suddenly dropped a line that indicated our relationship had progressed a step, making me want to tear my hair out.
It was a line that Jelasis says when the protagonist is confused and asks, "What’s gotten into you all of a sudden?"
After that, Jelasis would lean in close to the protagonist's face and, out of curiosity, suddenly try to kiss them, leading to a thrilling development.
In reality, the sudden turn of events would end in rejection from the protagonist, resulting in a lesson for Jelasis on not doing such things to people out of the blue.
As I recalled Jelasis's approaching face, I felt goosebumps.
It would be bad if others saw two guys leaning in close by the pool.
I should quietly deliver a Brave-style rejection punch to his handsome face; surely self-defense would be justified.
"Hey, what do you like about Alicia?"
With those words, my punch swung through the air.
Our faces, which had been too close, missed each other, and Jelasis whispered in my ear again.
"Why you? You shouldn't even be here."
"Huh—?"
Before I could comprehend the meaning of his words, Jelasis's body began to emanate a faint magical aura, and I realized.
I had recently encountered the owner of this magical power.
"...So it was you in the deepest part."
The blazing demon from that time.
"If that's the case, what will you do? Cause a ruckus here?"
Now that I think about it, when he countered Ekaterina's water sphere with a fireball, Jelasis hadn't been chanting.
I hadn't paid much attention to it, but the academy doesn't teach non-chanting, and even if he were a target character, he shouldn't be able to handle it.
At this point, I should have been suspicious about various things.
"...What do you want to say?"
"It's a declaration of war. I won't let you have Alicia."
He smiled with a devilish grin, and I genuinely thought about killing him right there.
But before that, I was called by a member of the reverse harem.
"Jelasis, you're not good with water, right? Let's practice together!"
"Hey, hey, Jelasis, what are you doing alone? Come over here!"
"I'm coming. I'm not good with water, but I'll do my best with Patricia."
The attention of those around us shifted to me, and I couldn't move.
I had promised to hold back at the academy, so I couldn't cause a scene.
"So you’ve never kissed anyone, huh?"
"...What of it?"
"I have. The last time was my loss, so now it's one win and one loss for me."
Had he anticipated that? Jelasis muttered a parting shot in a small voice and dove into the pool.
Even though he was supposed to be bad with water.
"Jelasis, what were you talking about with that person?"
"Just got involved again; it was Lady Ekaterina."
"I see, so you helped her out. That's a good mindset."
"Good job, Jelasis. Discrimination within the academy is not good."
The space filled with laughter and cheer once more.
As the girls watched Jelasis being praised and petted by the princes, they began to swoon, exclaiming, "So precious!"
"……I will seriously kill him, I will definitely kill him, right now."
A voice emerged from me that was shockingly low.
This declaration of war was quite blatant.
Why is it that you, who are raising flags with Patricia, are aiming for Alicia?
I don’t understand it, even though you're part of the reverse harem.
Since coming to the academy, I had been observing those guys, and Patricia was clearly following the reverse harem route.
Damn it, more than that...
"──You’ve never kissed anyone, huh?"
That parting shot stuck in my mind and wouldn't leave.
Hey, I can't contain my murderous intent.
This isn't just about romance; my desire to kill is overflowing, and I feel like I could lift all the water in this pool and swing it around, creating a murderous attraction.
Fine, fine, fine, this is great, this is great, this is great.
I was getting tired of sneaking around.
Having a clear declaration of war like this makes it easier to identify who the enemy is.
"I don't care about anything anymore. Those guys in front of me are the root of all evil, so I'll bring Onyx and turn their houses to dust──"
As I trembled with rage, Alicia hit me on the back of the head, bringing me back to reality.
When I turned around, there was an angel.
Even in a competitive swimsuit, her outstanding proportions surpassed Mariana's, threatening to shatter the tightly closed prison of the Brave beast within me.
That's the feeling I had, growl.
"What are you muttering about something so dangerous?"
"Uh, well, there's someone I want to kill."
"Did someone say something? You can't do that, you have to hold back."
Grrr. But I can't just stay silent after being mocked.
Alicia, who hadn't heard my conversation with Jelasis, glared at me with a suspicious look, seemingly misunderstanding.
"Lagna, I heard from Mariana that there are mysterious injured boys in your classroom... You're not doing anything weird, are you?"
Gulp.
The guys who had played pranks on me had all disguised their actions as accidents, making it impossible for them to pull their stupid pranks again.
I thought that breaking fingers and arms wouldn't be serious enough to get caught, but how did she find out?
Mariana, it's not good to snitch!
"You can't cause a scene; it will only make your position worse. I can endure anything said to me, so you should hold back too."
"Woof woof..."
Since she pulled out a collar from around her chest, I decided to obediently comply.
As a form of reflection, I would wear that collar today.
"I know you look dissatisfied, but do you really understand?"
"Woof!"
"Very well."
Though I had been playfully barking, it seemed that it had somehow conveyed my feelings.
"Well, you don't have to force yourself to wear the collar... There are people around, and this was something the servants gave me for when you acted unexpectedly."
"No, I'm wearing it today."
If I don't wear it obediently, my anger won't subside.
Alicia isn't mine; I am Alicia's.
I will show that difference in status to that bastard.
How about that? Isn't it amazing? Say it's amazing.
"Hey, Alicia, do you know where my glasses are?"
At that moment, Mariana returned.
"I just got a new pair, and now I can't find them anywhere! They were expensive!"
"Well, you're wearing them like a headband..."
"Oh! Found them! As expected of Alicia! You're my lifesaver!"
"Ugh... I can't leave you two alone for a second..."
Alicia sighed as the noise increased.
I didn't want to be treated on the same level as Mariana, but since I was in a state of reflection, I would accept those words.
"Don't group me with her! Lagna is way worse!"
"That's true, but you're pretty clumsy too, you know?"
I had finally accepted it, and then she called me worse.
Alicia, don't just accept it so easily.
"Ugh... what a mess..."
As I watched the two bicker, I sighed and thought.
Unexpected contact from an opposing force, and it was from one of the target characters.
I had been wary of the Ignite family.
However, a declaration of war from someone who was supposed to defeat that Ignite family in the original scenario was nothing short of unexpected.
Could it be that they sensed I had retrieved the pendant, realizing I was a similar existence?
The story, the fate, is steadily beginning to go awry.
I need to tighten my resolve and protect the two of them.
